_doc: Journal/export presets. Values are common author-guideline defaults; ALWAYS confirm against the target journal's current instructions and record the actual requirement in IR.style. width_mm is the typical single-column figure width; dpi is the minimum raster resolution; min_font_pt is the smallest legible label after scaling; color_space notes print expectation. These drive export_check.py.

nature.note: Single column 89 mm; double column 183 mm. Vector preferred; fonts embedded.

cell.note: Single column 85 mm; full width 174 mm.

ieee.note: Column width 3.5 in (~88 mm). Grayscale-friendly; fonts embedded; min 300 dpi.

elsevier.note: Single column 90 mm; 1.5 column 140 mm; double 190 mm. TIFF/EPS preferred.
